fusions.name: Levelling Tread
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground flat and deals 28 blunt damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. It ignores their armour.

fusions.name: Pile Driver
fusions.desc: Drops onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away and deals 8 blunt damage, rising to 1.8 times that at 6 tiles. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Weighted Hooves
fusions.desc: Increases your blunt damage by 30% and your dodge chance by 8% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Piling On
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You gain 5% dodge chance.
